channel.title: Prospect Heights on Gourmand Syndrome
channel.description: Recent content in Prospect Heights on Gourmand Syndrome

item.title: Inkaico
item.description: A buddy and I were near the Barclays Center looking for something to eat while we’re waiting for the doors to open for a competition. This restaurant opened in June 2025, and it has standard Peruvian affair like lomo saltado and ceviches. Because other restaurants were packed with diners also with the same mind, we decided to stop by here since Peruvian food rarely requires a wait. We walked in for 2 for lunch around 12:30 PM on a Saturday.

item.title: Olmsted
item.description: Was pretty good surprisingly, though the portion sizes were way too small. Ended up eating some rhubarb pie afterwards.

item.title: Daly Pie
item.description: Got the rhubarb, and it was pretty good. I love them rhubarb pies.

item.title: Ample Hills Creamery
item.description: Got the pistachio brittle, and it was mediocre. I think Van Leeuwen is better.
